newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai plans 1,000 new industrial products in 97.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai plans 1,000 new industrial products in 97.

text.p: Shanghai plans to develop more than 1,000 new light industrial products in 1997, with local banks offering support to the tune of 3.3 billion yuan ($274 million), the official Xinhua news agency said on Saturday.
Most of the new products were refrigerators, air conditioners, washing machines, microwave ovens, cosmetics and foodstuffs, Xinhua said.
A local enterprise had developed a direct current and frequency conversion air conditioner which had just gone on sale in Japan, it said.
Other firms were developing a pollution-free refrigerator, as well as environmentally friendly, or green, food and green packing materials, it said.
